title: Lincoln's Inn
scope: Standing Lincoln’s Inn collegiate group in Holborn: the Great Hall and Library, Old Hall, Old Square Chapel and undercroft, Chancery Lane Gatehouse and adjoining Old Buildings, and the two Stone Buildings ranges.
limitations: Primary named structures and the adjoining Old Buildings are within scope. Other chambers, modern underground facilities, New Square and detached park structures remain part of base Earth context.

Not all small parts have independent surveyed outlines. The Gatehouse’s return, late roof profiles, Stone Buildings court facades and fenestration are rationalized against the mapped blocks and historical sources.
The Great Hall and Library share a mapped outer footprint. Their joining structures, lead and slate roof segmentation, individual stained glass and heraldic panel details are approximated.
